understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked '+' in each level, ultimately winning the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement actions move the player one tile when possible and consume turns; gravity continuously pulls the player in the current direction. Clicking a clickable tile removes it and consumes a turn, but does not directly move the player. Spike tiles are hazards that end the attempt on contact. Each level allows two attempts with up to 50 turns. Undo/restart is available after failure, while ineffective moves do not change position but may still consume turns.
